unchanged_rules: Levels 1 through 20 keep existing time-based difficulty.
Standard/lite enemy caps remain at 280/180; bullet and hazard caps are retained.
Damage values, telegraph durations, charge speeds, invulnerability and control resistance retain their original rules.
Previously born enemies retain their stored stats during level-up and save/load.
XP drops remain separate, stationary outside pickup range, and fully preserved.

unit.campaign_method: Fixed seed per blade, legal movement/dash and offered-item selections only. After level 20 the bot prioritizes a first health item or survival upgrades when injured; no HP, XP, clock, damage or RNG overrides. Reachability proof, not a physical-device or human difficulty study.
